payload.feature:
LANDING PR for story #430, slice 3 (decision 0068 ruling 3's capacity half, and ruling 5's data): admission measures the machine's room from its own host configuration, a new machine-scoped contract forge.host/v1 at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/brokkr/host.json, else ~/.config/brokkr/host.json. An entry waits, with a typed reason naming the limit and the measured value, for:
- provider concurrency, and route concurrency (shared-local routes by their own ceiling);
- the scratch filesystem's free-space floor (the operated repository's .forge/scratch by default);
- the boxed-build ceiling.

What a running run seats is pinned at its compile (run-manifest/v13's model pins, carrying the route its driver serves each id on) and counted from that pin, never re-resolved through the admitting workspace. An absent, an unreadable and an invalid host file are three outcomes, all fail closed. Nothing starts runs yet; #430 stays open for the claim fence and start path, cool-downs and probes, the scratch sweep and `brokkr dispatch`.

THE OPERATOR'S RULING (2026-10-10, on #430): option B. Host capacity lives in a separate, machine-scoped host configuration with its own contract, not in the realms map; decision 0068 gains an addendum recording it.

The branch story-430-slice-3 ends at 8aef761c, a merge of main c9a205e1, over these commits off main 90d94dd8. One story run took five rounds (430c to 430f), each security hold real and narrower than the last:
- 7b561099: forge.host/v1, the reader, the four capacity checks, the 0068 addendum, the guide section.
- c2e7a2d8 (430d): a run is counted by the model ids its own compile pinned (run-manifest/v13); inline model seats carry their route; scratch at the repo's .forge/scratch; typed measurement errors; a dangling parent of the host file reads unreadable.
- f0e1de80 (430e): the effective route has one home (brokkr-protocol adapters/served_route.rs); a bare dsh id is counted against deepseek-official; the scratch probe tells a dangling or looping link from an absent component.
- e401d44a (430f): the host file is read through canonical::parse_strict, so a provider or route written twice is refused naming the key.
- 3fdc4f36 (controller): the exact-coverage gate's three regions, each bound with a removal control.
- 8aef761c (controller): merge of main c9a205e1. bundle.rs keeps both new modules; witnesses.json takes main's pins, then is re-blessed (18 pins move, all from v13's capability record).

The PR's Ruling line asks the operator to accept:
- two new contracts, forge.host/v1 and run-manifest/v13 (v12 and every existing contract byte-identical);
- brokkr-runtime's public API 1638 -> 1706 and brokkr-protocol's 949 -> 952 (split_route, AdapterKind::served_route);
- the witness pins that move.

It also restates the operator's open question: whether the temp dir, where oneshot boxes keep their scratch, is a second floor.

Every review position, panel member or chief, is READ-ONLY: it changes no tracked file and makes no commit, whatever this text asks below. It reports each finding. Only the implement phase fixes a finding the review returns.

Judge:
1. Fail closed everywhere capacity cannot be measured: an absent host file waits each entry undeclared; an unreadable one (looping, dangling or through-a-file paths included) holds and is never read as absent; an invalid one, a duplicate key included, refuses the pass; an undeclared provider or route waits; a live run whose seats cannot be resolved is RunUnmeasured.
2. That every running run is counted once against each provider and route it seats, from its own pinned record, whatever workspace admits; that shared-local routes use their own ceiling; that bare and qualified ids count against the route their driver serves.
3. That the scratch floor measures the filesystem that holds the operated repository's .forge/scratch, or the declared path, and never a parent's filesystem through a link.
4. That run-manifest/v13 sits beside a byte-identical v12, old manifests read as before, and every moved witness pin is the tests' own value; that contracts/README.md and the guide state what the code does.
5. That the merge of main c9a205e1 changes neither side beyond its two stated resolutions.
6. That the carried items are listed for the PR:
   - the census does not count AwaitingOperator runs, a time-of-check gap for the claim-fence slice;
   - a live run pinned before v13 makes every entry wait until it ends (fail-closed);
   - resolve_route's egress class for a bare dsh id is a follow-up;
   - the temp-dir second floor is the operator's question.

This run lands one pull request under decision 0051, so the contribution gate can vouch for it.

For the implement phase only: if a finding returns the branch, fix exactly that finding and prove it with a test bound by a compiling mutation. Then run, all clean: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy on the crates you touched, with -D warnings; typos --hidden; quality/ratchet.sh files, clones and api. Another session's U6c8 owns brokkr-protocol secret.rs and brokkr-cli broker/bootstrap.rs and broker/session.rs; bundle/mcp.rs and agents/mcp.rs are theirs too: do not touch them.

Commit one signed-off commit ending "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>", and never push. Do not run scripts/coverage-exact.sh; the controller runs it. Run every command in the foreground: never background a command or schedule a wakeup, because a headless seat ends when it waits.

Threat model (operator ruling, 2026-09-26): catch realistic accidental misuse, and fail closed on what cannot be read.

native.reason: dsh declares mcp and tool_permissions unsupported, which establishes only that Brokkr cannot narrow or extend its tool surface from the command line; it does not establish that dsh has no native egress of its own. On the contrary, recipes/research-dsh/README.md records that since dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 the headless profile ships web-fetch-http with page fetch on and a keyed search, so native egress is likely present and no OFF control for it has been declared or measured. Its native inventory, and any ON or OFF control for it, remain unmeasured: nothing is granted through dsh and no native denial is claimed (decision 0065 slice one; owed to the controller)

members.adversarial: Read-only adversarial review of story changes against main c9a205e1 and the 8aef761c merge. No new concrete inputs-to-wrong-output finding. Inspected host unreadability and strict duplicate-key parsing, compile pins and inline/fallback handling, per-run provider/route deduplication, shared-local ceilings, scratch ancestor/link probing, boxed counting, contracts, docs and merge resolutions. git show --remerge-diff shows only the stated bundle module and witness resolutions; frozen-surface diff adds host/v1 and manifest/v13 without changing existing contract bytes. Ran existing prebuilt test binaries: admission 43, bundle pins 2, frozen contracts 17, witness digests 6 (BROKKR_BLESS unset), served route 1; all 69 passed. git diff --check and git status --short were clean. No tracked edits, fixes or commits; no coverage-exact run. Confirmed the carried AwaitingOperator/claim-fence gap, pre-v13 live-run fail-closed wait, bare-dsh resolve_route egress follow-up and temp-dir second-floor question are recorded in delivery evidence for the PR; not reopened. Full build, lint gates and remote CI were not rerun by this seat.
members.correctness: Correctness and fit review of all six story commits 90d94dd8..8aef761c, the story delta against main c9a205e1, and the merge's combined diff. No new findings. Reviewed against docs/house-rules.md and decision 0071 rulings 1-10: effects above the pure core, closure seams, typed host outcomes and measurement errors, one served-route derivation shared with the driver, pinned per-run seats, and tests with exact variants and recorded compiling removal controls. Host absence waits, unreadable paths hold (dangling/looping links and through-a-file paths included), invalid and duplicate-key files refuse. Provider/cloud-route and shared-local counts deduplicate each run; census reads its own model pins without consulting the admitting workspace. Scratch probes the operated repository's .forge/scratch or declared absolute path and refuses unresolved links rather than measuring their parent. Boxed capacity checks only boxed entries. Existing contract bytes including v12 are unchanged; v13 adds only model_pins/served, existing readers are unchanged, and all moved witness values pass the tests without blessing. README, guide and 0068 addendum agree with the implementation. Merge resolutions retain both phases and pins modules and combine main's witness table pins with the measured v13 bundle pins. Public API counts confirmed: runtime 1638->1706, protocol 949->952. Observed tests: cargo test -p brokkr-runtime admission:: --locked (43 passed); --test it witness_digests:: (6), frozen_contracts:: (17); bundle::pins:: (2); cargo test -p brokkr-protocol served_route:: --locked (1); cargo test -p brokkr-cli --lib verbs::queue:: --locked (7). Total 76 passed; git diff --check clean and git status --short empty. Reviewed recorded mutation evidence; performed no mutations, fixes or commits. Four explicitly carried items remain listed for the PR in the delivery ledger: AwaitingOperator census exclusion/time-of-check gap for claim fencing; pre-v13 live runs block admission until ending; bare-dsh resolve_route egress class follow-up; temp-directory second floor awaiting the operator's ruling. These are the framed exclusions, not new findings. Claim/start, cooldowns/probes, scratch sweep and dispatch remain outside this slice and #430 stays open. Exact coverage and remote CI were not rerun by this seat.
members.glm: Correctness/fit review of 7b561099, c2e7a2d8, f0e1de80, e401d44a, 3fdc4f36 and merge 8aef761c against 90d94dd8; admission/pins/served_route/frozen-contracts/witness-digest tests run and pass. Fail-closed holds everywhere: absent file waits typed (host_undeclared); looping/dangling/directory/through-a-file paths hold (host_unreadable), never read as absent - unreached() follows the deepest existing ancestor, and a parent dangling link is Unreadable not Absent; an invalid file - wrong schema const, zero/negative/overflow ceiling, relative or null scratch path, unknown field, duplicate key at any depth - refuses the whole pass naming key and position (typed shape first, then canonical::parse_strict over the whole text); undeclared provider/route waits; a live run whose seats cannot be resolved (v12 manifest, unreadable pin, null route) is RunUnmeasured and every entry waits until it ends; an unfoldable journal refuses the measure; an unplaced host (no absolute XDG/HOME) refuses the pass. Counting is right: once per provider and per (provider, route) per run, from the run's own v13 pin (the two-workspace test proves no re-resolution through the admitting workspace's adapters), shared-local by its own ceiling in place of the provider's, bare dsh id on deepseek-official via the one rule the dsh driver itself reads (parse_dsh_model now shares it; behavior preserved), live lanes on undeclared keys counted as cloud (fail closed), and built-in model drivers always pin because the compile refuses an unpinned model seat, so Read([]) only comes from drivers that take no model. Scratch measures the deepest existing component of the entry's operated repo's .forge/scratch (the engine's own SEAT_SCRATCH) or the declared absolute path; a dangling or looping link on the path errors (ScratchUnmeasured) rather than measuring the parent's filesystem. run-manifest/v13 is machine-checked as v12 plus model_pins/served and nothing else; v12 is byte-identical and now digest-pinned in FROZEN; contracts/README and the guide state what the code does (the guide's sample is loader-checked). The merge changes exactly main's files on the branch side and the branch's files on main's side; bundle.rs keeps both modules, witnesses.json is a bundles-only 18-pin re-bless with tables untouched, and the API counts 1638->1706 / 949->952 check out. Nothing starts a run; the five files owned by U6c8 are untouched by the branch. Residual findings, all info, none returning the branch: (1, info) the census reads only the queue's own journal, so runs in a second brokkr journal on the same machine are invisible to the measure - consistent with decision 0068's one-queue-per-journal model, worth naming when the start path lands; (2, info) the census counts Status::Running only, so an AwaitingOperator run's seats are uncounted - the carried time-of-check gap, pinned by the not-running-arm test; (3, info) the capacity measure latches nothing and is advisory at list/judge time - enforcement belongs to the start slice; (4, info) host-file route keys are not validated against the route grammar (the schema cannot express key patterns), so a key no id can name is dead config, never fail-open. No security residual from this seat: the fail-closed posture holds on every path I could reach.

result.notes: Review chief, read-only. The panel reported (result 'residual', members adversarial=clean, correctness=clean, glm=residual at info); nothing under notes addressed the gate or argued for a verdict. I read the story delta c9a205e1..8aef761c myself (host.rs, capacity.rs, governing.rs, admission.rs, queue.rs, pins.rs, capabilities/manifest.rs, served_route.rs, launch/queued.rs, both contracts, README, 0068 addendum, read-surfaces guide, frozen_contracts.rs, witnesses.json, public-api files, canonical::parse_strict) and the merge's remerge-diff. Confirmed against the code: (1) absent host file waits as host_undeclared; looping/dangling/directory/through-a-file/dangling-parent paths hold as host_unreadable and are never read as absent (unreached() follows the deepest existing ancestor); invalid files refuse the pass via HostError::Invalid, duplicate keys through parse_strict after the typed shape; undeclared provider/route waits; a live run with a v12 manifest, an unreadable pin or a null route is RunUnmeasured; an unfoldable run refuses the pass; no absolute XDG/HOME refuses as Unplaced. (2) Running::count dedups providers and (provider,route) per run from the run's own model_pins; shared-local lanes are excluded from the provider count and judged by their own ceiling; Served::on uses AdapterKind::served_route, which parse_dsh_model now shares, so a bare dsh id counts on deepseek-official; collect_unpinned refuses an unpinned built-in model seat, so Read([]) only comes from exec/custom drivers. (3) scratch() measures the declared absolute path else the entry's operated repo joined with engine::SEAT_SCRATCH; free_bytes stops at the deepest component symlink_metadata finds and statvfs on a dangling/looping link errors rather than measuring the parent. (4) v12 bytes unchanged, sha256 matches the new FROZEN pin; v13 is v12 plus model_pins/served (machine-checked); README, addendum and guide state what the code does; witness_digests passes with BROKKR_BLESS unset. (5) remerge-diff shows only bundle.rs's two module lines and the witnesses.json bundle pins. (6) The four carried items are listed in the delivery evidence. U6c8's five files are untouched. Public API 1638->1706 and 949->952 verified by line count. Re-ran: admission:: 43, bundle::pins:: 2, frozen_contracts:: 17, witness_digests:: 6, served_route:: 1, verbs::queue:: 7, all passed; git status clean. Surviving findings, deduplicated, none returning the branch: [low, chief] a concrete model id with a leading '/' (e.g. --model /foo, admitted by command_pin's alphabet) pins route "" via split_route, which run-manifest/v13's served.route (minLength 1) refuses, so the compile can write a manifest outside its own contract; no fail-open (an entry on route "" waits RouteUndeclared, a running run on it counts against its provider), but the writer and the contract disagree on one input; a guard in split_route or the pin reader is owed. [info, chief] admission::host::Problem is reachable through HostError::Invalid::source but not re-exported, so a caller cannot name it. [info, chief] Capacity::ScratchUnmeasured waits where host_unreadable holds, though a dangling scratch link is equally operator-mendable; fail-closed either way, asymmetry worth a line. [info, glm] the census reads only the queue's own journal, so runs in another journal on the same machine are invisible; consistent with 0068's one-queue-per-journal model. [info, glm] the census counts Status::Running only, so AwaitingOperator seats are uncounted (the carried time-of-check gap). [info, glm] the measure latches nothing and is advisory at list/judge time until the start slice. [info, glm] host-file route keys are not validated against the route grammar, so a key no id can name is dead config, never fail-open. No security residual; no spec defect.
